1.web: “Call now; is there any who will answer you? To which of the holy ones will you turn?
1.asv: Call now; is there any that will answer thee? And to which of the holy ones wilt thou turn?

2.web: For resentment kills the foolish man, and jealousy kills the simple.
2.asv: For vexation killeth the foolish man, And jealousy slayeth the silly one.

3.web: I have seen the foolish taking root, but suddenly I cursed his habitation.
3.asv: I have seen the foolish taking root: But suddenly I cursed his habitation.

4.web: His children are far from safety. They are crushed in the gate. Neither is there any to deliver them,
4.asv: His children are far from safety, And they are crushed in the gate, Neither is there any to deliver them:

5.web: whose harvest the hungry eats up, and take it even out of the thorns. The snare gapes for their substance.
5.asv: Whose harvest the hungry eateth up, And taketh it even out of the thorns; And the snare gapeth for their substance.

6.web: For affliction doesn’t come out of the dust, neither does trouble spring out of the ground;
6.asv: For affliction cometh not forth from the dust, Neither doth trouble spring out of the ground;

7.web: but man is born to trouble, as the sparks fly upward.
7.asv: But man is born unto trouble, As the sparks fly upward.

8.web: “But as for me, I would seek God. I would commit my cause to God,
8.asv: But as for me, I would seek unto God, And unto God would I commit my cause;

9.web: who does great things that can’t be fathomed, marvelous things without number;
9.asv: Who doeth great things and unsearchable, Marvellous things without number:

10.web: who gives rain on the earth, and sends waters on the fields;
10.asv: Who giveth rain upon the earth, And sendeth waters upon the fields;

11.web: so that he sets up on high those who are low, those who mourn are exalted to safety.
11.asv: So that he setteth up on high those that are low, And those that mourn are exalted to safety.

12.web: He frustrates the devices of the crafty, So that their hands can’t perform their enterprise.
12.asv: He frustrateth the devices of the crafty, So that their hands cannot perform their enterprise.

13.web: He takes the wise in their own craftiness; the counsel of the cunning is carried headlong.
13.asv: He taketh the wise in their own craftiness; And the counsel of the cunning is carried headlong.

14.web: They meet with darkness in the day time, and grope at noonday as in the night.
14.asv: They meet with darkness in the day-time, And grope at noonday as in the night.

15.web: But he saves from the sword of their mouth, even the needy from the hand of the mighty.
15.asv: But he saveth from the sword of their mouth, Even the needy from the hand of the mighty.

16.web: So the poor has hope, and injustice shuts her mouth.
16.asv: So the poor hath hope, And iniquity stoppeth her mouth.

17.web: “Behold, happy is the man whom God corrects. Therefore do not despise the chastening of the Almighty.
17.asv: Behold, happy is the man whom God correcteth: Therefore despise not thou the chastening of the Almighty.

18.web: For he wounds, and binds up. He injures, and his hands make whole.
18.asv: For he maketh sore, and bindeth up; He woundeth, and his hands make whole.

19.web: He will deliver you in six troubles; yes, in seven no evil shall touch you.
19.asv: He will deliver thee in six troubles; Yea, in seven there shall no evil touch thee.

20.web: In famine he will redeem you from death; in war, from the power of the sword.
20.asv: In famine he will redeem thee from death; And in war from the power of the sword.

21.web: You shall be hidden from the scourge of the tongue, neither shall you be afraid of destruction when it comes.
21.asv: Thou shalt be hid from the scourge of the tongue; Neither shalt thou be afraid of destruction when it cometh.

22.web: At destruction and famine you shall laugh, neither shall you be afraid of the animals of the earth.
22.asv: At destruction and dearth thou shalt laugh; Neither shalt thou be afraid of the beasts of the earth.

23.web: For you shall be allied with the stones of the field. The animals of the field shall be at peace with you.
23.asv: For thou shalt be in league with the stones of the field; And the beasts of the field shall be at peace with thee.

24.web: You shall know that your tent is in peace. You shall visit your fold, and shall miss nothing.
24.asv: And thou shalt know that thy tent is in peace; And thou shalt visit thy fold, and shalt miss nothing.

25.web: You shall know also that your seed shall be great, Your offspring as the grass of the earth.
25.asv: Thou shalt know also that thy seed shall be great, And thine offspring as the grass of the earth.

26.web: You shall come to your grave in a full age, like a shock of grain comes in its season.
26.asv: Thou shalt come to thy grave in a full age, Like as a shock of grain cometh in in its season.

27.web: Look this, we have searched it, so it is. Hear it, and know it for your good.”
27.asv: Lo this, we have searched it, so it is; Hear it, and know thou it for thy good.
